name: Frostwolf Banner
summary: In Alterac Valley, Horde initiates seek the Frostwolf Banner in Wildpaw Cavern. Recovering it is an ancestral rite of passage that awakens their battle spirit and earns their first clan insignia.

sections.title: A Rite of Passage
sections.body: Horde warriors seeking a place among the Frostwolf clan face a trial of grit in Alterac Valley. Warmaster Laggrond sends new recruits south into Wildpaw Cavern, where territorial gnolls fill the damp, hostile corridors. Reaching the hidden banner and bringing it back unbroken proves their courage and shows their battle rage has awakened. The trial earns each warrior the Frostwolf initiate's insignia.

faq.q: Why is the Frostwolf Banner inside a gnoll cave?
faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond and the clan use the banner's place in Wildpaw Cavern as an initiation test. New fighters must enter gnoll territory, face danger, and shake off complacency to awaken their battle spirit.

faq.q: Who do I return the Frostwolf Banner to?
faq.answer: Return the banner to Warmaster Laggrond in Alterac Valley. Presenting it to him welcomes an initiate into the Frostwolf ranks and earns an insignia of standing.

faq.q: Why does the standard look unusual for a Frostwolf crest?
faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond recognizes the banner as a clan trial standard, though its markings resemble older tribal insignias. Those include symbols associated with early orcish clans from the old Horde.

angles.text: Recovering the banner formally bloods a warrior into the Frostwolf clan under Warmaster Laggrond.
As an orc, returning a clan standard from savage gnolls honors the Frostwolf clan's legacy and Thrall's ancestral heritage in the Alterac mountains.
